item.title: Earlier Menopause Linked to Faster Cognitive Decline and Brain Changes
item.description: Earlier menopause was linked to faster global and episodic memory decline, earlier Alzheimer diagnosis, and faster white matter changes.

item.title: Why More Medicine Isn't Making Us Healthier [PODCAST]
item.description: Listen and follow on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, and more. America spends nearly a fifth of its economy on health care, yet chronic conditions persist.

item.title: Triple Agonist Drug Shows Substantial Weight Loss in Diabetic Patients
item.description: New research to be presented at the EASD Annual Meeting in Milan, Italy, from Sept 28 to Oct 2.

item.title: Traction Alopecia: Wig-Induced Cases in Children
item.description: Case reports highlight the link between tightly secured wigs and vigorous movement with hair loss in several young girls.
